verdict.learned_skill: Every evaluated policy strongly exceeds random legal play.
verdict.strong_external_play: Not established; surviving policies are badly outmatched by the full-information Oak search baseline.
verdict.longitudinal_improvement: Unverifiable retrospectively: earlier comparable checkpoints were deleted. Cross-policy ranking and training dashboards are not a learning curve.

protocol.rules: RBY OU, level 100, max stats, 512 update cap, root draft starts, no shaping or resets
protocol.seats: Equal games in both seats for each block
protocol.intervals: Approximate Wilson score intervals; draw counts as half. No multiple-comparison or winner-selection adjustment.
protocol.external_information: Oak receives full state; neural policy receives ordinary private observations.
protocol.oak_engine: Native engine controls all actual outcomes. Oak fork is not byte-identical; native fields and legal choices checked every turn.
protocol.oak_search_rng: Internally random_device seeded; archived game/draft seeds and per-game outcomes do not imply bitwise search repeatability.
protocol.hardware: CPU evaluation; GPU service and user checkpoints unchanged
